instruction: One empty pale blue fitted crib mattress cover, soft polyester fabric only, lying loosely flattened with its elastic opening facing the camera. Rectangular 133 by 71 cm outline, long axis vertical. The opening is clearly empty, with loose gathered fabric and flexible corners. No mattress, foam slab, padding, crib, baby or printed motif.

One pale blue polyester crib BED VALANCE textile, viewed from directly overhead. A flat rectangular central mattress-deck fabric panel, 133 cm long vertically and 71 cm wide horizontally. Four attached pleated fabric drop panels are folded closely underneath its four edges. Show the central rectangular deck panel clearly, with small pleated edges. It is bedding, not a wearable garment: no waistband, waist opening, belt loops, flared silhouette, person, crib or mattress.

One copper-colored rectangular cake-pan COVER, outer face up, viewed exactly straight down. A continuous closed slightly domed smooth outer surface with a narrow downward fitting lip around its perimeter; 33 cm wide horizontally by 23 cm deep vertically. No visible open tray interior, no raised tray walls, no handle or knob, no pan underneath.

One empty copper-colored deep loaf tin. Camera directly above the center at 90 degrees, looking vertically down: true plan view, with no external front wall visible. Rectangular opening 26 cm wide horizontally and 13 cm deep vertically, exactly twice as wide as deep. Deep inner sidewalls are equally visible on opposite sides. No lid or handles.

One copper-colored twelve-cup muffin tray, photographed from directly overhead. Exactly TWELVE equally sized circular cup wells: FOUR columns across and THREE rows down. Each of the three rows contains four cups, forming a regular 4 by 3 grid. Outer footprint 35 cm horizontally by 26 cm vertically. Empty cups, one connected tray, no food or loose cups.

One copper-colored metal wire cooling rack, viewed exactly straight down. A rectangle 40 cm horizontally by 30 cm vertically, four units wide by three units high. Regular evenly spaced straight horizontal and vertical wires join a continuous rounded rectangular perimeter. White background visible through every grid opening. No solid backing tray, no handles, no perspective tilt.

One empty copper-colored rectangular cake tin, photographed exactly straight down from directly above its center. Outer opening 33 cm horizontally by 23 cm vertically, only about one and a half times as wide as deep. Opposite inner walls equally visible. No external front wall, no perspective tilt, no lid or handles.

One empty copper-colored shallow-rimmed baking sheet, true straight-down overhead plan view. Outer rectangle 40 cm horizontally by 30 cm vertically: four units wide by three units deep. A continuous low rolled rim with rounded corners. No handles, lid, food, tilt or external front wall.

One slim polished silver stainless steel DINNER KNIFE, flat top view, blade pointing upward and handle downward. Narrow asymmetric dining blade with a gently rounded tip, straight blunt spine on one side and a fine dining cutting edge on the other. Total length 23 cm, maximum width only 2 cm, very slender 11.5 to 1 silhouette. Classic smooth rounded teardrop handle, no engraving. Not a spreader, dagger or cake server.

One polished silver stainless steel salad fork viewed straight down, four short evenly spaced tines pointing up and a classic rounded teardrop handle pointing down. A short fairly broad fork, 17 cm overall length and 3 cm maximum width, total silhouette about 5.7 times taller than wide. Broad four-tine head, no engraving.

One polished silver stainless steel two-prong serving fork photographed straight down. Exactly TWO long pointed metal prongs separated by ONE open gap. No middle prongs. Broad U-shaped two-prong head at top, classic rounded teardrop handle at bottom. Overall length 25 cm and head width 4 cm, 6.25 to 1 silhouette. No engraving.

One polished silver stainless steel slotted serving spoon, straight-down top view, oval bowl pointing up and classic rounded teardrop handle down. Three long fully open parallel slots through the bowl, showing clean white background through all three openings. No dark reflections or faces in the metal. Total length 25 cm and maximum bowl width 5 cm, five times taller than wide.

One slim polished silver stainless steel butter spreader, flat overhead view, short blunt rounded blade upward and smooth teardrop handle downward. Narrow flat blade only 2 cm across, total utensil length 18 cm: very slender nine to one outline. Blade is short relative to the long handle, rounded and blunt, not a broad cake-server paddle. No engraving.

One compact outdoor armchair, true straight-down bird's-eye plan view. Dark tightly woven rectangular frame, two short arms and one back, fitted gray seat cushion and gray back cushion. Nearly square footprint, 72 cm wide horizontally by 80 cm deep vertically. A normal upright sitting chair, not a recliner or chaise; no extended leg rest, headrest cushion or loose pillow.

One backless outdoor footstool, viewed exactly vertically down from above. Dark woven frame and a single fitted gray upholstered top. Its rectangular top is wider horizontally than vertically: 65 cm left-to-right by 55 cm top-to-bottom. No back, arms, legs visible beyond the top, loose pillow or camera tilt.

One broad outdoor sofa, camera vertically above for a true plan view. Dark woven frame with one connected back and two arms; fitted gray seat and back cushions. Footprint 180 cm left-to-right and 82 cm top-to-bottom, over twice as wide as deep. Wide horizontal silhouette, not a square loveseat. No loose pillows, table, extra chairs or camera tilt.

One dark woven outdoor coffee table, camera exactly vertically above. Rectangular dark plain inset tabletop with a continuous woven border. Footprint 105 cm horizontally by 58 cm vertically, about 1.8 times wider than deep. No objects on top, no chairs, no camera tilt or external front face.

One bronze table lamp, front elevation. A broad tapered round bronze shade, connected straight bronze stem and round bronze base. Overall lamp height 60.5 cm and shade width 35 cm: compact silhouette only 1.73 times taller than its widest shade. Broad shade and short stem, not a tall narrow lamp. Complete object with no extra lamps, cord or decoration.
